title: Capture & Dissemination of Stakeholder Information
html:
1. POLICY STATEMENT

The hospital is committed to establishing a structured system to collect, analyze, and disseminate feedback and information from all stakeholders—patients, visitors, staff, management, external agencies, and the community—to enhance quality of care, safety, and patient satisfaction.

2. PURPOSE

  • To ensure systematic capture of stakeholder inputs
  • To facilitate timely communication and action
  • To support continuous quality improvement (CQI)
  • To maintain transparency and accountability

3. SCOPE

This policy applies to:

  • All departments and units of the hospital
  • All stakeholders:
    • Patients & Attendants
    • Visitors
    • Hospital Staff
    • Management
    • External Agencies (vendors, ambulance, fire, police, labs)
    • Community representatives

4. DEFINITIONS

  • Stakeholders: Individuals or groups interacting with hospital services
  • Feedback: Complaints, suggestions, compliments, or observations
  • Dissemination: Sharing analyzed information with relevant stakeholders

5. RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Quality Department: Overall coordination and monitoring
  • Department Heads: Ensure implementation within departments
  • Front Office/Nursing: Collect patient & visitor feedback
  • HR Department: Capture staff feedback
  • PRO/Administration: Liaison with external agencies & community
  • Management: Review and decision-making

6. PROCEDURE

6.1 CAPTURE OF INFORMATION

A. Patients & Visitors

  • Feedback forms (IPD/OPD)
  • Bedside feedback rounds
  • Complaint/suggestion boxes
  • Digital platforms (SMS, email, apps)
  • Discharge feedback forms

B. Staff

  • Employee satisfaction surveys (biannual)
  • Staff meetings & departmental briefings
  • Suggestion systems
  • Incident/variance reporting

C. Management

  • Review meetings (monthly/quarterly)
  • KPI dashboards
  • Internal audits

D. External Agencies

  • Vendor review meetings
  • Ambulance/fire/police coordination feedback
  • Service-level agreements (SLA) reviews

E. Community

  • Health camps feedback
  • Public awareness programs
  • Social media/community outreach inputs

6.2 DOCUMENTATION

  • All feedback recorded in:
    • Feedback forms/registers
    • Complaint management system
    • Digital databases
  • Each entry includes:
    • Date
    • Source
    • Category (complaint/suggestion/etc.)
    • Department involved

6.3 ANALYSIS OF INFORMATION

  • Conducted by Quality Team monthly
  • Tools used:
    • Trend analysis
    • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Categorization:
    • Clinical
    • Administrative
    • Safety-related
    • Service quality

6.4 DISSEMINATION OF INFORMATION

Internal Dissemination

  • Departmental meetings
  • Email circulars
  • Notice boards
  • Quality committee meetings
  • Training sessions

External Dissemination

  • Feedback to patients (complaint resolution)
  • Reports to regulatory bodies (if required)
  • Communication with external agencies
  • Community awareness updates

6.5 ACTION & FOLLOW-UP

  • Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) initiated
  • Responsibility assigned to departments
  • Timeline defined
  • Follow-up audits conducted
  • Closure documented

7. FREQUENCY

  • Feedback collection: Daily/continuous
  • Analysis: Monthly
  • Management review: Quarterly
  • Staff surveys: Biannual

8. CONFIDENTIALITY

  • All feedback handled confidentially
  • Patient and staff identity protected
  • Data used only for quality improvement

9. INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Patient satisfaction score (%)
  • Number of complaints per 100 patients
  • Complaint resolution time
  • Staff satisfaction score
  • Incident reporting rate

10. RECORDS

  • Feedback forms
  • Complaint registers
  • Meeting minutes
  • Audit reports
  • CAPA records

Retention: As per hospital policy (minimum 3–5 years)

11. REVIEW & REVISION

  • Policy reviewed annually or as required
  • Approved by Hospital Management
